title: Q-SAYDO-rules-RULE-REFS-1: says RULE-REFS-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:RULE-REFS-1
**Status:** open

The system states `RULE-REFS-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation rulerefs --check: FAIL /webmention: site route no page links and no doc names (RULE-REFS-1: write the words, or add the owner, in the same change); rulerefs: 1508 references, 1456 resolve, 52 external with a reason, 0 

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:RULE-REFS-1` exits 0.
